svg.title: Zhan Kuatuly
svg.desc: Technical Lead at NDS. I run the backend of the AI assistant for a city of 2 million and lead the team behind the platform for its sports venues. The picture is a cutaway: Almaty at night on top, the back end under the street. In the picture: 2,553 stars, one for each test of Almaty Seasons; 366 lit windows, one for each of its API endpoints. Under the street: Almaty Seasons. The AI assistant for Almaty residents. I am its entire backend and infrastructure team. Cutting the tools offered per request from 18 to 2 to 4 fixed tool calling in Kazakh. The bottleneck was a prompt of about 11,800 tokens, not model size. 366 API endpoints, the lit windows in the city above. 2,553 tests, the stars in the sky above. 12 weeks to build, as its only backend engineer. DSS. One platform for Almaty's municipal sports venues. As technical lead, I built the money path myself. Its parts: leasing, events, tickets, access control and analytics. The diagram shows tickets. The card acquirer reports a declined payment as HTTP 200 with a false success flag. A callback that arrives twice is applied once. 46 days to the first real ticket sale, counted from the first commit. 2.5 min CI run time, cut from 51 minutes. 10 people, on the team I lead. Arlan School. School safety and education quality in one platform for Almaty schools, with video and audio analytics. Three levels, 10 roles: city and district: weekly indicators, a map of schools, AI analytics that leads to tasks for schools; school: attendance checked against turnstiles, lesson analysis from recordings, cameras and safety events; classroom: AI Teacher, AI Tutor, AI Kitap and a quest room. Deeper: my own workshop. Open source. Switchyard, open source. An LLM gateway in Python. A provider dies mid-answer, and another model finishes the same stream. Measured against mock providers. Real APIs have had only a smoke test. 6,000 of 6,000 requests completed, with 30% of streams cut or stalled. 1,306 broken streams, all finished on the second model. 0.96 ms added before the first token, at p95, at 200 requests a second. Dastar, open source. A reservation engine in TypeScript and Postgres. Double booking is refused by the database, not by application code. Run the race: docker compose run --rm demo. For an AI agent: MCP server, 4 tools; agents hold, people confirm; audit, claims checked. 4,999 of 5,000 requests refused, One gets the table and none overlap. 1,225 double-booked pairs the usual way, a plain check-then-insert, with only 50 clients. 12 invariants enforced by Postgres, with 843 tests, most against a real Postgres 18. Deeper still: where I worked before NDS. Older is lower. SmartTourist, 2025 to 2026: First engineer, hired as CTO. I built the backend from zero through to the company's acquisition by NDS. Avto-Time, 2024 to 2025: Founding engineer of a car service booking platform. It grew to 10,000 monthly users and raised a $500K seed. ExploreTest, 2024: Co-founder, in San Francisco. Pitched on stage at CESV 2024 and exhibited at TechCrunch Disrupt 2024. Crocos, 2023 to 2024: Backend engineer at an agency. I built backends for Almaty Metro and the Astana International Forum.
